The '''Battle of Hardscrabble''' occurred on [[Muskree]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Osaji Hux]] anonymously hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to kill her two siblings and rivals within the [[Osaji Syndicate]], then had them go to kill her on Muskree, where she revealed her identity to them and had her people attack them. At the same time, a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the command of [[Arhul Crace]] arrived. They had been trying to capture the leaders of the Osaji Syndicate and hoped to arrest Hux. A storm also hit the town and made [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] unusable as the three factions began a chaotic three-way fight. A group of townspeople then also joined the battle, as they hoped to ambush Hux and her minions. They were also hostile to the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. The final outcome is unknown.
